chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natanah (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from Ja'far b. Salama al-Ahwazi from Ibrahim b. Muhammad. He said: Abu'l-Husayn Ali b. al-Mu'alla al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: I was informed from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both) that he said:

Surely, for Allah there are regions called Vengeance. When Allah gives a servant wealth and that servant does not pay what is due to Allah the Mighty and Majestic from it, Allah inflicts upon him a piece of land from those regions, so the wealth is squandered therein, then he dies and abandons it.

key_terms.المنتقمة: The Vengeance — a name for certain regions where wealth is lost as divine retribution
key_terms.حق الله: The right of Allah — the obligatory dues owed to Allah from one's wealth (such as zakat and khums)
key_terms.سلط الله عليه: Allah inflicts upon him — divine imposition of loss as punishment for withholding dues

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about the consequences of not paying Allah's dues from one's wealth?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq warns that Allah has regions called 'Vengeance'. When Allah gives a servant wealth and that servant fails to pay what is due to Allah from it, Allah inflicts upon him a piece of land from those regions where the wealth is squandered, and then the person dies leaving it behind.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him
